meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: Claude 会到 cmem.ai 的记忆库中搜索过往观察,筛出与问题相关的记录,用平实的话回答;若问“什么时候”会引用时间戳,不会直接导出原始搜索结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“search memory”“mem search”“check claude-mem”等指令,或询问某个项目、决策、文件等的先前会话上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下记忆:我们上次登录的路由错误是什么?
say.note: 触发记忆搜索并返回相关记录。

say.text: 关于这个项目,你记得哪些关键决定?
say.note: 用关键词检索记忆库,总结相关点。

say.text: 查 claude-mem,找之前提到的超时设置
say.note: 搜索该词的相关记录并摘录。

howto.what_en: Claude searches the user's memory on cmem.ai, extracts relevant timestamped observations, and answers in plain language without dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'search memory', 'mem search', 'check claude-mem', or asks for prior-session context about a project, decision, or file.

say_en.text: Search my memory for the route error from our last session.
say_en.note: Runs a memory search and returns relevant observations.

say_en.text: What key decisions do you remember about this project?
say_en.note: Retrieves memory entries matching the project.

say_en.text: Check claude-mem for the timeout settings mentioned earlier.
say_en.note: Looks up related observations on that term.
